sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by direct node fetch with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed <table class="tier-list"> rows: first <td> = tier letter, each <span class="tier-list-entry"> block's FIRST img alt = "Spec Class". 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page, applied via apply-ratings.mjs. Era-verified per <title>: every page reads Midnight / Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1 (raid DPS "Midnight (12.0.7)", tank raid "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1") and Devourer Demon Hunter is present in both DPS lists — no season flip. Page-own dates (JSON-LD dateModified) 2026-06-30/07-01, unchanged from the morning run. ZERO tier moves vs the committed state. This is the SECOND run of 2026-08-02 (the first landed 03:02 UTC), so the stored asOf was already today before this run started; every source below was nevertheless re-fetched live and re-merged this run, and the detail states whether any value actually moved.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 221-358 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)" — correct for this era-gated source, and it stays out of the live consensus by registry construction (era: "ptr"). 38 rated rows parsed (26 DPS + 7 healer + 5 tank) on the 6-band icyveins-ptr scale; the two upstream TBDs were re-verified in the page text (Augmentation Evoker under the DPS list, Vengeance Demon Hunter under the tank list) and written as explicit nulls, not omitted — 40 rows applied. published re-read as 2026-07-26 (JSON-LD dateModified), i.e. the authors have not rebuilt the list since the last Sunday stream; that lag is normal for this source. ZERO tier moves.

Both pages fetched live by direct node fetch, HTTP 200 (165 KB M+ / 153 KB raid). Parsed the tier__tier blocks (tier__title letter + data-original-title spec labels); 8 non-spec labels in the M+ block are dungeon names and were correctly discarded. 79 assignments (40 M+ + 39 raid), 0 unmatched roster rows. Vengeance DH remains absent from the raid list — the documented long-standing omission, left absent rather than invented. Era-verified: Devourer present in both lists, "Midnight" on both pages, no Season 2 / 12.1 self-identification. Method publishes no dateModified. ZERO tier moves — content still unchanged since its 2026-03-31 revision.

All 6 pages fetched live. Direct HTML carries only the JS shell (the guide body is client-rendered), so the documented r.jina.ai proxy transport was used for all six — HTTP 200, 13-49 KB of markdown each — and the "<n>. Spec Class (X Tier)" ranking block was parsed. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched. Two parse hazards handled and worth recording: Wowhead writes the tier as a HYPHENATED "(S-Tier)", which a naive [SABCDF][+-]? pattern reads as a non-existent "S-" band (it produced 13 phantom one-notch moves on the healer/tank pages before the fix), and the M+ DPS page has a typo'd "16. Subtlety Rogue B Tier)" with no opening paren — the prose confirms B, and a tolerant paren match recovers the 27th row rather than dropping the spec. Era-verified per title: all six read "Midnight Season 1", Devourer present. ZERO tier moves.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists): raid = the THROUGHPUT tierList, M+ = the SCORE tierList, never the default popularity grouping. 80 rows (27+7+6 per bracket), 0 unmatched icons, applied via apply-ratings.mjs. Archon's own lastUpdated is 2026-08-01T12:00:00Z on all six pages — the same daily aggregate the 03:02 run ingested, which is why there are ZERO tier moves; that is upstream cadence, not a fetch failure.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Venomous-era raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 with a parseable __NEXT_DATA__ blob and every encounter yielding all 40 specs. 680 tier rows written to data/encounter-tiers.json (asOf 2026-08-02); stored display names were preserved because Archon's page title field is the generic list title, not the encounter name. ZERO tier moves — the file is byte-identical to the committed state, matching Archon's 08-01 aggregate.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, merged via apply-metrics.mjs survivability key. ZERO tier moves (Archon lastUpdated still 2026-08-01T12:00:00Z).

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows, n = parses. Kept to the stored convention of DPS + tank specs only — the raid healer page also exposes a dps column, and ingesting it would silently widen the series to 40; healers publish under the HPS name instead. Values identical to the committed state (Archon's 08-01 aggregate unchanged).
"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses. Values unchanged vs the committed state — same Archon 08-01 aggregate.
"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. Values unchanged vs the committed state — same Archon 08-01 aggregate.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention. Values unchanged vs the committed state — same Archon 08-01 aggregate.

Fetched correctly via the JSON API and never the stale HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200 on plain fetch with no headers or proxy. 44 blocks returned; whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField "lowerBound" + keyRange undefined = 3 blocks / 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched (classSpec names are byte-identical to the roster). PARTIAL because the upstream snapshotDate is still 2026-07-28 — 5 days behind this run and unchanged for the third day running — and asOf must be the source's own date, never today. Stored data is therefore correct but lagging; maxAgeDays 4 in the contract is the alarm that matters and it is now exceeded, so this needs a human look at whether wowmeta's Blizzard-API snapshot pipeline has stalled upstream. Values re-merged at the stored 2-decimal precision (an initial integer rounding would have shown 39 phantom moves; corrected before applying, net 0 changes).

label followed by the rating in the infobar. Merged as "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" — kept explicitly as a top-50 ceiling, never popularity and never a letter. Best-build DPS taken at target counts 1/2/3/5/8/15 and merged via apply-metrics.mjs profiles key; fightProfile.asOf 2026-08-02 on all 26. Zero target values moved vs the committed state — Bloodmallet had not re-simmed since the 03:02 run. Augmentation has no chart by design (unsimmable support spec); healers and tanks get no profiles by design.

Header confirms World of Warcraft 12.0.7.68887 Live, iterations=7500. 49 MID1_{Class}_{Spec}_{HeroVariant} profiles read; best variant per DPS-roster spec kept = 26 rows (Augmentation absent by design), tank profiles at the bottom of the ranking correctly excluded. All 26 values moved vs the committed state — this is a genuinely newer nightly than the one the 03:02 run read (e.g. Frost DK 137709 -> 137666, Feral Druid 133637 -> 133736).

Direct fetch on /period/latest, which 302-redirects to /period/1074 and serves the chart server-rendered (205 KB). Parsed the "Spec representation in top keys" figure: 39 rows, 0 unmatched, merged as "Top-2000 keys representation" (unit %). Same weekly period 1074 as the 03:02 run, so zero values moved. Devastation Evoker is absent from the figure entirely — verified by grepping the raw HTML for devastation-evoker (zero occurrences), so this is a genuine upstream absence from the top-2000 keys this period, not a parse gap; its stored row keeps its older asOf rather than being invented.

NO NEW PTR BUILD OR POST — nothing to log, nothing changed, no tier-set upkeep due. The official thread's Discourse .json was fetched live (HTTP 200, 406 KB): highest_post_number is 19 and post #19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31) is already the newest entry in data/ptr-builds.json, so the feed is current. Wowhead news RSS fetched live (HTTP 200, 214 KB, 40 items parsed per <item> block, not by tag adjacency): newest items are 2026-08-01 and none is a class dev-notes build (Achievement Panel back button, Warband campsites, Season 2 great-vault unlock info). The 2026-07-31 "Patch 12.1 PTR Hotfixes" article (news=382321, Freightrunner trinket + Evoker Twin Flame/Consume Flame + Shaman Ride the Lightning +59%) was re-read in full from the RSS content:encoded — it remains the third-channel case documented in ptr-watch step 3a, and it is still NOT logged for two reasons that are both structural rather than judgement calls: every class line sits under a bare CLASS heading with no spec qualifier, and ptr-builds.json requires a forumUrl on a Blizzard forum host, which a PTR hotfix round-up does not have. Flagging for a human as the standing open item. Spec writeups: the 9 uncovered specs (Frost DK, Feral/Guardian/Restoration Druid, Holy Priest, Elemental Shaman, all three Warlocks) were re-checked — the RSS window carries no 12.1 review article for any of them, and Wowhead's own search is Cloudflare-403 to the runner and returns unrelated content through r.jina.ai, so the Wowhead lane stays exhausted and the Discord/paste lane remains the path. No writeup was manufactured from tuning lines. No season flip: every source still reads 12.0.7 / Season 1 live with Season 2 explicitly labelled PTR.
